purpose.zh: 拉开后腿大腿根前面和大腿前面，坐久了胯前面发紧最管用
purpose.en: Stretches the front of your back hip and thigh, great when sitting leaves your hips tight.

text.zh: 上身挺直，夹紧屁股把胯往前送
text.en: Stand tall, squeeze your butt, ease your hips forward

text.zh: 后脚脚背搭在矮凳上，前脚踩稳，两手叉腰。
text.en: Top of your back foot on the stool, front foot planted, hands on your hips.

text.zh: 后膝贴地别动，屁股夹住，大腿前面一路被拉开。
text.en: Back knee stays put, butt squeezed, feel the front of that thigh open.

text.zh: 呼气时屁股再夹紧一点，胯往前送一点点。
text.en: Each breath out, squeeze a little harder and nudge your hips forward.

commonErrors.zh: 胸口往后仰，腰被折成拱
commonErrors.en: Leaning your chest back and bending your lower back.

commonErrors.zh: 上身往前趴，大腿前面没拉到
commonErrors.en: Leaning forward so the front of your thigh loses the stretch.

cautions.zh: 拉到舒服的拉扯感就行，太紧就上身往前倾一点
cautions.en: A comfortable pull is enough. Too tight? Lean your chest forward a little.

cautions.zh: 后膝底下垫块软垫，膝盖不舒服就往前挪一点
cautions.en: Put a soft pad under your back knee. If the knee feels off, shift forward a little.
